# Compiler command line

`takibi <file.tkb>... [flags]`: 22 flags, from the table in `bin/main.ml`. GitHub issue #1027 plans their consolidation.

## Target and output (5)

| Flag | Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-o` | `<output.o>` | object file to write |
| `--target` | `<triple>` | LLVM target triple (default: the host) |
| `--cpu` | `<cpu>` | LLVM target CPU |
| `-g` | - | emit DWARF debug information |
| `--version` | - | print the compiler version and exit |

## Codegen (2)

| Flag | Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--frame-pointers` | - | keep AArch64 frame-pointer chains (the kernel debugger walks them) |
| `--function-sections` | - | one section per function and global, for the linker's --gc-sections |

## Policy gates (10)

| Flag | Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--forbid-trap` | - | reject any compiler-inserted trap site |
| `--forbid-unsafe` | - | reject a reachable unsafe effect |
| `--confine-raw-authority` | - | only the --raw-mint-file files may mint raw authority |
| `--raw-mint-file` | `<path>` | a file allowed to mint raw authority (repeatable) |
| `--require-execution-model` | `<path>` | check the execution-model declarations in this file |
| `--device-semantics-file` | `<path>` | a file allowed to declare device semantics (repeatable) |
| `--regions` | - | enable the region built-ins |
| `--reject-unused-functions` | - | reject a function nothing reachable uses |
| `--external-entry` | `<function>` | a function called from outside Takibi (repeatable) |
| `--check-unused-file` | `<path>` | restrict the unused-function check to this file (repeatable) |

## Compiler development (3)

| Flag | Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--internal-tla-omit-cache` | `publish\|finish\|refresh` | with --generate tla, leave one cache step out (fault control) |
| `--internal-trace-init-flow` | `<function>` | print a function's init state after each statement |
| `--internal-range-obligation-fault-control` | - | plant known-unsound range rules (z3 check's failing control) |

## Fact files (12)

`--facts DIR` writes every one of these, under these names.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `deps.d` | Make depfile: the use closure, then the policy files the compile read |
| `rawderef.tsv` | every raw-pointer dereference (#639) |
| `rawsites.tsv` | raw-authority site count per file (#739) |
| `callgraph.tsv` | the resolved call graph (docs/CALL_GRAPH.md) |
| `globals.tsv` | each mutable global's protection, then every use (docs/GLOBAL_PROTECTION.md) |
| `heldguards.tsv` | the guards held at each call |
| `overflow.tsv` | each checked arithmetic site and its operand facts |
| `rangeobl` | a directory: one SMT-LIB file per range obligation (docs/RANGE_OBLIGATIONS.md) |
| `structs.tsv` | every struct's LLVM field offsets, then its .size and .members |
| `frame-offsets.inc` | each exception frame's offsets as GAS .equ constants |
| `debug-metadata.json` | debugger metadata: discriminant names and variant layout |
| `allocwords` | the OCaml words this compile allocated, written at exit (#923) |
